title: S2b · vertical SMF-28 → D 263-index glass top → IOX buried 0.3 mm (hypothetical)
description: Hypothetical 0.3 mm burial in 2.0 mm of glass with the D 263 index, to show what the family needs; neither value is a process or product claim. With 1.1 mm the family has no candidate at any depth tried.
